title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-05-30 Noether author record with paper-level readers through Paper 10
description:
Author record for Emmy Noether in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record keeps earlier broad working readers while a paper-by-paper source-and-translation edition replaces them.

Status at a glance. [##########] current paper-level stream through Paper 10; [##########] TeX and source-checking artifacts preserved. Top-level readers include paired cumulative original German and English readers for Papers 1-10, a paired reader for Paper 10, earlier individual Paper 1 and Paper 2 readers, and older broad working drafts. The next continuation point is Paper 11.

The artifact ZIP preserves TeX sources, component PDFs, source-scan sidecars for checking, render checks, and build reports.
notes: Latest update promotes the paired paper-level Noether cumulative through Paper 10 and adds Paper 10 as an individual paired reader.
